note: Glossary skill: what a --md-sys-* token MEANS and when to reach for it. Fences: the three consumption siblings own binding/recipes/values for their axis (color/typography/geometry), motion-tokens owns easing/duration, raw values route to the owning consumption skill, non-Material prefixes have no owner here. #263 diet wave (2026-08-15): description trimmed to the W8 <=700-char budget, blind re-judged via /check-routing design, one heal round applied where trimming cut a load-bearing trigger phrase — clean after heal. #723 fix (2026-08-19): n09/n10 added — border/focus-ring width CONSUMPTION asks (a "which token" pick, not "what does it mean") were stolen by this skill's own prefix list naming border/focus-ring; reciprocal fence added naming material-shape-facts as the consumption owner, description re-dieted to the W8 budget in the same change. First re-diet dropped two of the three worked trigger examples and the explicit color/typography/geometry glossary-scope framing — a fresh full-suite blind judge caught 3 regressions (t02 stolen by material-type-facts, t05 dead, t08 stolen by material-shape-facts); healed by restoring the scrim-strengths example, the glossary-scope clause, and a general "difference between two token families" framing, trimming the M3-baseline fence's lead-in wording (not its mandatory verbatim quoted phrase) to hold budget. A second full-suite blind judge fixed t05/t08 but t02 ("what is the kicker voice for") was stolen by material-type-facts on BOTH judges (2-of-2, majority locked before a 3rd vote could change it) — the description's three worked examples were all color-domain, none typography, so a typography-flavored meaning-ask read as material-type-facts' own "which voice/level" trigger instead. Healed by swapping in a typography-domain example ("what's the kicker voice for") and trimming the M3-baseline fence's supporting clause further to hold budget. A third full-suite blind judge (fresh shuffle) came back 18/18 clean, including t02 — done. Three-judge history on t02 is 1 fail (pre-heal) / 2 pass (post-heal), a clean 2-of-3 majority; every other case held clean across all three judges. Wording-checker caught a real defect the routing judges didn't (routing tolerance isn't a language-layer pass): the YAML `>-` fold's line break landed mid-identifier twice ("focus-\nring}-*" and "material-\nshape-facts"), so the RENDERED description carried two spurious spaces, though the worked example phrasing elsewhere stayed correct. Reflowed so no fold point falls inside a hyphenated token (whitespace-only, verified byte-identical to the intended string via yaml.safe_load); no routing re-verification owed since the intended string content is unchanged.
